_comment: Strings the design drop does not ship: accessibility labels, the cookie-consent banner (the drop has none, though its own cookie policy promises one), the shortened mobile announcement, and newsletter consent wording. Authored here rather than in ui.json so content/ui.json stays a faithful extract of the drop. Deep-merged over ui.json by scripts/build-pages.js.

faq.a: Right after checkout you get a download button on the confirmation page and an email with your files. Nothing is shipped — print at home or at any copy shop.

faq.q: What ages are Cadomalo products for?
faq.a: Each product shows its own age range: the picture books are for ages 3–7, the busy book, science kit, escape room and party kit for ages 5–7 (the party kit has tips for 3–4 and 8–10), and the personalised birthday story for ages 3–8.
Every Human Body Wonders and Medical Heroes book has each page in English, French, Spanish and German. The activity kits and the personalised storybook are in English.

faq.q: Can I print more than once?
faq.a: Yes — as often as you need for your own family, or for one classroom. Sharing or reselling the files is not allowed.
Our 30-day happiness promise: write to support@cadomalo.com and we’ll fix it or refund you.

faq.q: Pour quel âge sont les produits Cadomalo ?
faq.a: Chaque produit indique sa tranche d’âge : les albums pour les 3–7 ans, le cahier de routine, le kit de sciences, l’escape game et le kit de fête pour les 5–7 ans (avec des conseils pour les 3–4 et 8–10 ans pour la fête), et l’histoire d’anniversaire personnalisée pour les 3–8 ans.
Chaque livre Merveilles du corps et Les héros de la santé a toutes ses pages en français, anglais, espagnol et allemand. Les kits d’activités et le livre personnalisé sont en anglais.
Oui, autant que nécessaire pour votre famille ou pour une classe. Le partage et la revente des fichiers sont interdits.
